posts.author: Gaurav_Shivhare
posts.community: Sheela Foam - An exciting branded play
posts.text: Difficult times like the current macro/geopolitical environment test structural scale. While SFL’s 3x revenue advantage over Wakefit provides a natural buffer, the key will be seeing how efficiently larger players translate this size into operating leverage once raw material pressures stabilize. Furlenco’s profitability and potential IPO definitely add a nice optionality/value-unlock catalyst to track.
